value.description:
`value`: The numeric value of the monetary amount.
This is represented as a decimal number (e.g., 100.50).

currency.description:
`currency`: The currency associated with the monetary value.
It refers to a `Currency` type, which defines the currency symbol and code (e.g., USD, EUR).

title:
Type `MonetaryValue` represents a monetary amount with a specific value and currency.
It holds the value as a decimal and associates it with a specific currency type.
name: MonetaryValue
